offering_description.value: Builds and maintains roads, highways, bridges and site work for public and private owners, using asphalt and aggregates produced at its own plants and quarries across several southern and southwestern states.

primary_services.value: highway and road paving; bridge and grading construction; site work; road maintenance and repair

customer_segment.value: B2G: state and local transportation departments, municipalities, counties; B2B: general contractors, private developers, commercial site owners

end_markets.value: public infrastructure; commercial and residential development; transportation

revenue_model.value: project or contract: fixed-price and unit-price contracts for road and bridge construction work; product sales: asphalt, aggregates and concrete sold to contractors and customers

value_chain_position.value: service provider: performs paving and heavy civil construction work, sold to government agencies and contractors; OEM / manufacturer: produces asphalt mix and concrete from its own plants, sold to construction projects; asset operator: owns and runs quarries, asphalt plants and equipment fleets
value_chain_position.category: service provider; OEM / manufacturer; asset operator

geography_served.value: US regional: Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas

specialization.value: related lines: paving and road construction, aggregates, asphalt and concrete production, road maintenance

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bids on public road and bridge contracts and negotiates private work directly; own locations: company-operated quarries, asphalt plants and concrete plants that supply projects

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental permits for quarries and asphalt plants, safety rules, and public contract and prevailing wage requirements
